tags: why do dogs look worried when spoiled
script: You are actively spoiling your dog, treats, belly rubs, a full blanket burrito, and somehow their face still looks mildly concerned about the whole situation. Part of that is just facial structure, a lot of breeds have eyebrow markings, wrinkles, or ear positions that read as worry to us even when the dog feels completely relaxed, it's a human pattern-reading thing more than a dog emotion thing. But some of it is real too, dogs pick up on the fact that this much attention is slightly unusual, and a small part of their brain is genuinely processing, what is happening right now, is this normal. That mix of processing and pure enjoyment can show up on their face as something that looks like concern, even mid blissful belly rub. It's not distress, it's closer to mild, happy confusion. hookText: That's not worry. It's something else.
